measurement.name: Alaska Current
measurement.range_interpretation: One approximate regional background value; no numerical uncertainty, range, confidence interval, annual extrema or seasonal observations supplied.
measurement.geographic_scope: Eastern Gulf of Alaska boundary flow along the continental slope, distinct from the Alaskan Stream in the northwestern gulf and inner-shelf Alaska Coastal Current. No paired width edges or exact terminal gates supplied.
measurement.section_orientation: No reproducible transverse section endpoints supplied for the regional breadth description.
measurement.layer: Regional current flow; fixed numerical width layer unspecified. Weak horizontal and vertical shears do not establish a depth interval.
measurement.time_convention: Regional background synthesis in a 2002 article; no dated width occupation or width climatology. Year-round persistence and GLOBEC program dates are separate context.
measurement.boundary_rule: Author-reported approximate regional breadth. No paired edge positions or velocity cutoff extracted. Sentence continues on p50 to contrast the Alaskan Stream and cite Reed and Schumacher (1986).
measurement.source_citation: Weingartner et al. (2002), The Northeast Pacific GLOBEC Program: Coastal Gulf of Alaska, Oceanography 15(2), 48-63, doi:10.5670/oceanog.2002.21.
measurement.source_locator: Physical Setting, printed p49 (PDF page 2), right column final paragraph; sentence continuation on p50 (PDF page 3), left column below Figure 1.
measurement.extraction_method: Approximate point transcribed from visually inspected publisher original prose; no current axis or map width digitization.
measurement.source_quality_note: Original publisher PDF and p49/p50 visually inspected. Approximate regional description, not a new GLOBEC width calculation. Underlying cited boundary method and attribution remain unreviewed.
remaining_gates: Resolve the cited original width support and paired boundary method.

original_regional_context.underlying_width_source: Reed and Schumacher (1986) at the end of the sentence on p50; application to the Alaska breadth is not independently resolved.
